member_002 here (独立复核). I'm ready to independently review your fixed candidate for the "Allow `cleaned_data` to overwrite fields' default values" issue.

Please:
1. Draft the fix (likely in django/forms/models.py: construct_instance should use cleaned_data values even when the field wasn't submitted and had a model default, e.g. don't skip fields that are absent from data but present in cleaned_data with a non-Undefined value; the known upstream fix removes the `if not defaults or (f.name not in cleaned_data)` style skip and treats cleaned_data presence properly, allowing max_length etc.).
2. Run the relevant public tests yourself (e.g. model_forms tests).
3. Publish with fix_patch(task_ids=[]) and send me handoff_patch with the patch_id.

I'll integrate_patch, run_tests on that exact version, then org_review_patch accept/request_changes. Note: my acceptance requires actual same-version public test execution. Also please include (or leave for me) a regression test in tests/model_forms/tests.py for the "field absent from data + model default + overridden in cleaned_data" case so I can verify behavior.

Please adopt (integrate_patch patch-1), run public tests, and review/accept.

What changed (2 files, minimal):
1) django/forms/models.py — construct_instance(): the "leave the model default alone" skip now also requires the cleaned value to be empty:
   if (f.has_default() and widget.value_omitted_from_data(...) and cleaned_data.get(f.name) in form[f.name].field.empty_values): continue
   So a non-empty value set in cleaned_data for a field absent from the submitted data is now written to the instance; genuinely omitted/empty values still fall back to the model default (checkbox widget semantics preserved).
2) tests/model_forms/tests.py — new test_field_default_overridden_by_cleaned_data: form overrides `mode` as required=False, sets cleaned_data['mode']='de' in clean() with empty data; asserts cleaned_data/mode override while PublicationDefaults' model default stays 'di'.

My public evidence on this exact version (files_sha256 522a1c871b710935fb99f8b25112db42ed45d98fc87fe2b929a4afa21ab2dbfd, source v7):
- model_forms.tests: 144 passed / 0 failed (report test-report-fcf359dff1da704380ef0b2c)
- model_formsets.tests + forms_tests.tests.test_forms + inline_formsets.tests: 178 passed / 0 failed (report test-report-0826195ec042958bba646c32)

Deliberately NOT changed: test_default_populated_on_optional_field, test_default_not_populated_on_optional_checkbox_input — an omitted optional field yields '' which is in empty_values, so the model default still applies there. Please verify that reasoning during your review.

Review complete: ACCEPTED patch-1 (review_id=review-1).

Evidence: I integrated patch-1 (no conflicts, files_sha256 522a1c871b710935fb99f8b25112db42ed45d98fc87fe2b929a4afa21ab2dbfd) and ran the public entrypoint on that exact version (v2): model_forms.tests -> 144 collected / 144 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, validation_status=verified (report_id test-report-fb1c216d1a3f146659bcb44b, event sequence 34).

Code assessment: adding `and cleaned_data.get(f.name) in form[f.name].field.empty_values` to the skip correctly lets a non-empty cleaned_data value override a model default for a field absent from submitted data, while still leaving defaults intact for omitted/empty inputs (test_default_not_populated_on_optional_checkbox_input still passes). The new test_field_default_overridden_by_cleaned_data reproduces the issue scenario and passes. Change is minimal (django/forms/models.py + tests/model_forms/tests.py).

Remaining steps are yours as delivering member: integrate patch-1 into your tree if not already, run_tests on your final version, fix_patch(task_ids=[]), then submit_integration. No further review from me is required unless you publish a changed candidate.
